summary: TEN MESSAGES. Five from Sarah, five from ALTR (Mayson 4, Mica 1). Last week there were 62. This is the quietest week in the account's four-month history by a factor of two, and the shape of it is worse than the size. Every single one of Sarah's five messages this week was her supplying, or apologising for not being able to supply, a credential: 'Landed :)', 'apologies I won't be able to get Facebook now that phone is in my checked bag so will have to get tomorrow', 'Yeah can send that now', 'Ready now :)', and then '[REDACTED-2FA-CODE]' — a live Snapchat 2FA code, the third in three days and the sixth secret ALTR has extracted from her in a fortnight. She has not said one word about her OnlyFans page, her chatters, her whale, her streams, her Meta accounts or her money. HER LAST MESSAGE TO US WAS A 2FA CODE, AT 2026-09-19T13:43, AND SHE HAS NOT SPOKEN SINCE. That is five days and nineteen hours of silence at window close, still running, the longest client silence on this account since July and the only one that has ever followed a week in which she raised nothing at all. A SECOND MESSAGE HAS BEEN DELETED MID-CREDENTIAL-EXCHANGE. Message id 986 is missing from the export, sitting exactly between her 'Yeah can send that now' at 09-18T09:45:26 and Mayson's 'Let me know when you're up' at 09-19T02:49 — i.e. the Snapchat 2FA code she sent on 09-18 is gone. Last week id 970 vanished from the identical position in the identical exchange. Two deletions, two weeks, both of them precisely where a live secret was posted. THE PAYMENT DUE DATE PASSED IN TOTAL SILENCE, AGAIN. The Sept 1-14 invoice went out 09-15 on 7-day terms and was due ~2026-09-22. Not one person on either side mentioned money at any point this week. Stephski wrote zero messages (last post 09-16). No 'Received!' — her last one was 2026-08-26, now 30 days ago and two full cycles. And this is the cycle in which she was moved off the ALTR Platform Services LLC account ending 4709, the only rail her bank has ever accepted, onto a renamed 'ALTR Management' account that nobody has ever verified receives an inbound international wire from her bank. The last time she was moved onto an unverified account her bank bounced the wire twice and Derrek had to chase her three times. We do not know whether we have been paid, we do not know whether the new account works, and the invoice she was sent carried the sentence 'As always we appreciate you paying within the next 7 days to avoid any pausing in work!'. THE DMCA REPORT HAS NOW BEEN MISSED TWICE. Michelle's weekly leak-removal report landed nine weeks running without a gap — 07-10, 07-17, 07-26, 08-01, 08-10, 08-17, 08-25, 09-01, 09-08 — then missed 09-15 and has now missed 09-22. Michelle has written nothing in this chat since 2026-09-10, fifteen days. Sarah has never chased it, and she is not chasing it now. THE ONLY NON-MAYSON MESSAGE ALL WEEK WAS A CONTENT CHASE, AND SHE DID NOT ANSWER IT. On 09-23 Mica wrote 'Hey @sarahlloydd! 💕 Just a quick reminder to please upload your content to the Google Drive when you get a chance so we can keep everything organized and up to date. Thank you!!' — the third chase on a brief that is now 26 days old, sent nine days after Sarah told us on 09-16 exactly why she cannot execute it ('I do have a full time assistant who uploads across all of my accounts so just can be hard trying to find things that she hasn't already uploaded'), and nobody has done anything about that blocker. She has not replied. Two days and counting. Before this week she had answered every direct request inside a day for four months. SHE ALSO DIDN'T DELIVER THE FACEBOOK LOGIN SHE PROMISED. On 09-18 she said she would get it 'tomorrow'. It never came, and Mayson — who wrote four messages this week, all of them asking for codes — has said nothing since 09-19T02:49. Nobody has followed up on anything. THE STALE STACK AGED ANOTHER SEVEN DAYS WITH ZERO MOVEMENT, FIFTH CONSECUTIVE WEEK. Noah 0 messages (last 2026-08-25, 31 days), Derrek 0 (31 days), Ronnie 0 (30 days), the vendor 'Sarah Lloyd chat team' 0 (102 days), Michelle 0 (15 days), Stephski 0 (9 days), Vivek 0 (8 days). She has now gone 31 days without mentioning her biggest whale.
